docs.text: I strongly recommend vibing on Lake Ontario in a dinghy with about a dozen friends. Touch lake is even better than touch grass.
You might think you can guess what it is in reply to. I assure you you will be wrong. Touch grass, y’all. Or at least some high-quality Lake Erie astroturf.

Yeah the lawn thing is a bummer but I hope a good amount of that is in non-locally constrained areas like my in-laws who live on the shore of lake michigan and water their large front lawn in the summer and that’s gotta be fine. Obvs that’d be shitty in many areas of the country.
Well spring is slowly getting here.. not much grass is green yet, but the lake looks to be in a better mood these days😁
Man, the one thing I miss sometimes about the old place is the hyper local and very active weather posters and hashtags. Especially with this storm rolling in to the Great Lakes tomorrow.
My touch grass #stunday, picking raspberries at community farm on a Lake Superior foggy day… of course I couldn’t resist some snaps!!

had a landscaping company in AZ try to sell me on a lawn when my request was "sustainable desert scape" immediately went to another company and told them exactly why. I've been a fan of kill your lawn since I lived on the great lakes, I'll be damned to have one in a desert
Can’t wait to go touch grass on the other side of Lake Michigan.
Nothing here but bare grass and open water on the shore of Lake Erie 😊 Hope it stops soon.
i will be attempting to touch grass (and possibly lake huron) for the next 5 days, wish me luck

Growing up in The Great Lakes region, I'm pretty accustomed to verdant fields and soft grass. Recently I visited a development in Vegas for work, and it felt like I was in one of those fake nuclear testing neighborhoods with the astroturf lawns. So unsettling.
You are so bloody fortunate to have a lawn!! At one time, I had two acres (on Lake Michigan, at that!)

On a much less bittersweet note, my dad's house has the softest grass I've ever stepped on. My daughter would've stayed running around his backyard all day if we let her. And we got to take her to see Lake Erie, her first experience with a big body of water. It's (surprisingly) actually clean now
Touching grass at Cherry Beach before I go feral for 3 months ☀️🏖 #toronto #bb27
